high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "barelyopinionated." The post is part of a series titled "How is a trust used," and it is currently on slide 7 out of 10. Text: The main body of the post explains what a trust is and how it is used. It states that a trust is an arrangement where a third party, referred to as the trustee, holds assets on behalf of someone for their benefit. The post further elaborates that trusts are commonly used for estate planning purposes and succession planning, helping large business families to consolidate
